name: OpenVector
long_description: OpenVector transforms any existing camera into an automated 24/7 workforce without requiring new hardware. We've built the world's fastest vision-language model inference engine that allows users to simply describe a task in plain English and automatically build a custom AI vision model to monitor their feed. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action. It integrates with legacy systems, makes calls, sends emails, updates a POS/CRM, or triggers webhooks in real time. OpenVector enables any camera to do real work.
one_liner: AI that turns any camera to an autonomous worker with real-time vision

launches.title: OpenVector - Self-improving AI that turns any camera into an autonomous worker.
launches.tagline: Most cameras just record. We give them the ability to do real work.
launches.body:
**TLDR;** OpenVector turns existing cameras into an automated 24/7 workforce. Describe a task in plain English, and it auto-builds a custom vision model that takes real-time actions on a computer when it spots an event.

**Ask;** If you or someone you know runs physical operations (manufacturing, logistics, retail, security) and wants to automate visual tasks without buying new hardware, we’d love to connect!

**Our Launch Video:**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=36OaIJ4FPZ8>

**Our Team:**

OpenVector was founded by a team of builders and engineers obsessed with bringing self-improving visual intelligence to the physical world.

* [Andrey Gizdov](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreygizdov/), CEO, dropped a fully-funded **PhD** scholarship from Fulbright, worth **$170,000**, with invitations at **Harvard and MIT**, where he worked on real-time vision models.
* [Vishal Urlam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishal-urlam/), CTO, previously automated camera systems and network protocols for Tata, the **second-largest network infrastructure in the world**. CMU embedded systems engineer.

**Problem**:

Many important business moments happen in the physical world: Someone tailgates. A production cycle stalls. A worker skips a step in the manufacturing process. A customer arrives, and no one responds. There are over 1 billion cameras worldwide, but they only record it for later. For physical operations, the best technology available to catch these events in real-time has been a human staring at a monitor.

**Solution:**

OpenVector is an AI that brings action to any camera.

* **Plain English to AI Model:** No coding or expensive setup. Simply describe your task in plain English, and OpenVector automatically builds the best AI vision model for it, and watches your camera feeds 24/7. It’s an app that takes 2 minutes to download and set up, and works with any camera.
* **Acts Like a Human:** OpenVector operates a computer just like a human based on what it sees.
* **Legacy Integration:** It automatically integrates with your existing systems to make a call, send an email, update your POS or CRM, or trigger a webhook the second an event happens.
* **Zero New Hardware:** Works entirely with the cameras you already have installed (custom end-to-end solutions also available).

**We’ve Already Started:**

OpenVector is already live and seeing use cases across security, retail, manufacturing, and logistics. We are tracking production cycle efficiency directly from existing CCTV, ensuring good-manufacturing-practices, and catching physical design errors.

**Now Onboarding:**

OpenVector is ready to deploy on your camera feeds today. Contact us if you’re tired of cameras that only watch and want them to actually do work for you. [founders@openvector.com](mailto:founders@openvector.com)
